title: Book
description: A catalogue book in Firestore books/{book_id} (PRD 9). Real open-licence African children's books only: title, author, licence, attribution and the publisher's level come from the book and its publisher, never invented. Producer: the book ingestion job aloai-book-ingest (W2), idempotent on file_hash. Consumers: book ranking and the Reading Coach's search_books (W3: vector search on embedding, then aloai_scoring.rank_books), and the web app's report screen (W1: title, author and attribution). A book whose estimated level is more than 2 ARL from its publisher level is held for a person to check and is never recommended while held. Contains no child data.

publisher.description: Where the book comes from, e.g. African Storybook, Book Dash, StoryWeaver.

licence.description: The licence as the publisher states it, e.g. CC BY 4.0. Checked per title at ingestion.

attribution.description: The attribution text the licence requires, shown wherever the book is shown.

publisher_level.description: The publisher's own reading level, as the publisher writes it (e.g. 'Level 2').

arl.description: The publisher level mapped to the Alo Reading Level. The level used for ranking.

estimated_arl.description: The rule-based text-level estimate (PRD 9.2), as a cross-check on arl.

held_for_review.description: true when |estimated_arl - arl| > 2, until a person checks it. Held books are not recommended.

west_african_setting.description: The book is set in Nigeria or West Africa (PRD 9.3 Culture term).

description.description: A short description of the book. With the topic tags, it is the text that is embedded.

embedding.description: The text embedding of description plus topic tags (cosine distance), stored as a Firestore vector field or a Cosmos DB vector path. Always 768 numbers: text-embedding-3-small is asked for 768 dimensions.

embedding_model.description: Pinned per deployment (text-embedding-005 on GCP, text-embedding-3-small on Azure). Vectors from different models are not comparable, so a new model means re-embedding every book (and the interest queries) together.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw file; re-running ingestion on the same file changes nothing.
